page_title: MON 3-0 STR | Monaco v Strasbourg 20/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Ruddy Buquet has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Monaco are ruled offside.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' Substitution. Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) has come on for Caio Henrique.
88' Adi Hutter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Chrislain Matsima (Monaco) replacing Denis Zakaria.
85' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Strasbourg) gets booked for the first time in this match.
84' Gerzino Nyamsi (Strasbourg) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Ruddy Buquet has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) replaces Takumi Minamino.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aleksandr Golovin trots off the pitch and is replaced by Krepin Diatta (Monaco).
79' A substitution has been made. Thomas Delaine goes off and Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) comes on.
79' Here is a change. Gerzino Nyamsi is going off and Patrick Vieira gives the last tactical orders to Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg).
78' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) is about to take a corner kick.
78' The resulting corner from Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
77' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Strasbourg are awarded a corner kick.
75' There's an opportunity for Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Strasbourg) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
73' A corner kick by Monaco is thwarted by the well prepared Matz Sels (Strasbourg).

73' A big opportunity is wasted by Eliot Matazo (Monaco), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the bottom left corner. Unfortunately for him, Matz Sels pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
70' It will be a substitution. Eliot Matazo (Monaco) is ready to enter the pitch as Mohamed Camara walks off.
69' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
67' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) latches on to a loose ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot on goal, but the effort lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the left post.
66' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is flagged for offside once again, but it was a very tight call this time.
64' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
61' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
59' Patrick Vieira has decided to substitute Kevin Gameiro and he is replaced by Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg).
59' Lebo Mothiba goes off the pitch and Angelo (Strasbourg) comes on.
58' 3 - 0 Goal! Takumi Minamino plays it to Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Matz Sels. 3:0.
56' Vanderson (Monaco) tries to find Takumi Minamino, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
55' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity from the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
54' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Matz Sels is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
52' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) takes the corner with a short pass.
52' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
51' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Monaco can continue in their attacking effort.
49' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Monaco was in an offside position.
47' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+7' The free kick into the penalty area from Jessy Deminguet (Strasbourg) is cleared.
45+3' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Strasbourg) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and fires the ball to the roof of the net, but Philipp Kohn is alert and thwarts the effort.

45+3' It looks like Denis Zakaria (Monaco) saw red with that tackle. Ruddy Buquet won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Strasbourg are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
45' Vanderson (Monaco) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
42' Poor challenge! Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Strasbourg) is penalised for tripping and Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle.
41' Gerzino Nyamsi (Strasbourg) plays a terrific long ball forward to Lebo Mothiba, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.

36' 2 - 0 Caio Henrique produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Takumi Minamino (Monaco) rises high to head the ball into the right side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 2:0.
35' The referee shows the yellow card to Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco).
35' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Matz Sels, who smothers the ball.
32' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
30' Thomas Delaine swings the cross over. Lebo Mothiba (Strasbourg) gets his head to it but it goes just over the crossbar.
29' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) misses a big chance after the ball is crossed into the penalty box, with his shot going well wide of the right post.
27' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
23' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

20' 1 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Takumi Minamino (Monaco) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the left post. Matz Sels just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:0.
17' A short pass finds Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
15' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) sends a cross into the box, but Philipp Kohn comes off his line to gather the ball.
12' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Monaco will take a throw-in.
10' Jessy Deminguet (Strasbourg) sends a long ball in, but Philipp Kohn comfortably gathers the ball.
6' The ball is cleared after Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
4' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Monaco will take the kick-off.
Ruddy Buquet will referee today's match.
